Cartoon casino lounge bossa nova. Vibraphone, brushed drums, walking bass, muted horns, relaxed but playful. Seamless loop.
Strolling big-band groove for a cartoon property board game: walking upright bass, muted trumpet melody, brushed snare, xylophone answers, a sly confident swagger. Seamless loop.

Sunny, scheming big-band groove for a cartoon island-building board game: marimba and steel drum melody over slap bass, bongos, muted trumpet answers and sly trombone slides. Busy and bouncy, like a crew racing to build. Seamless loop.
